t: Pack of loft legs raise loft floor on top of ceiling joists in boarded lofts used as storage by 175mm; allows for the fitting of up to 270mm of insulation. Maintains U values, to help save energy. Strong, lightweight and easy to install. Roof trusses are designed to take 25kg/m² of storage and the weight of a person in the loft; a storage deck, supported on these loft legs can easily support the same loads. Not suitable for use in habitable rooms. Strong plastic construction. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
